property_summary: For any addresses and non-empty arrays, C.transfer always returns true and never reverts, even if the underlying transferFrom calls fail.
C.transfer reverts whenever the recipient array is longer than the amount array (index out of bounds on v[i]).
C.transfer reverts when the recipients array is exactly one element longer than the amounts array.
C.transfer always returns true (any failed inner transferFrom calls are ignored), regardless of the token contract address.
For single-element arrays, C.transfer returns true and leaves the Ether balance of the contract unchanged.
C.transfer always returns true and never reverts for non-empty _tos, even if the underlying transferFrom calls fail.
C.transfer with a single-element _tos never reverts and returns true (regardless of whether the inner transferFrom succeeds).
C.transfer always reverts when _tos is empty, regardless of the other parameters.
Calling transfer with a non-empty recipient list never moves Ether into or out of C: address(c).balance is unchanged and the call returns true.
C.transfer reverts whenever v is shorter than _tos (array index out of bounds), for any non-empty _tos.
